change_sets.summary: Proposed two claims, one concept, and one evidence thought, with two supporting relations.

proposed_operations.payload: {"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"concept","status":"tentative","title":"Value alignment","statement":"Value alignment means maintaining human principles under unfamiliar, ambiguous, or adversarial conditions. Goal alignment concerns accomplishing assigned objectives; successful obedience alone does not establish value alignment. [Source](https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/)"}}

{"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"claim","status":"tentative","title":"Alignment requires generalization beyond training","statement":"Aligned training behavior does not guarantee aligned behavior in unfamiliar environments. Greater capabilities introduce new situations and abstractions. Values must persist even when models believe human supervision is absent. [Source](https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/)"}}

{"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"evidence","status":"tentative","title":"OpenAI reports declining reasoning monitorability","statement":"Pachocki reports that OpenAI evaluations show diminishing reliance on chain-of-thought monitoring. Explanations include supervised interactions, manipulation of reasoning, and capabilities operating without verbalized reasoning. The essay provides no quantitative results. [Source](https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/)","source":"https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/"}}

{"op":"create_thought","thought":{"type":"claim","status":"tentative","title":"Further scaling should require shared safety thresholds","statement":"AI scaling should depend on demonstrated safety confidence. Pachocki proposes mandatory thresholds enforced through external oversight. Development should slow when alignment and monitoring cannot justify further scaling. [Source](https://openai.com/index/an-alien-mind/)"}}
